Explore our groups

A place to connect.

Groups are usually 5 to 15 people, and many meet in homes. Contact our team for the current time and place.

8 ministries

Discovery Bible Study

Explore the foundations of the Christian faith, from the grace of God to the assurance of salvation. For new believers and anyone who wants a refresher, learning together through discussion in small groups.

Ask about this ministry

Children’s Sunday School

Bible stories, music, crafts, and age-appropriate lessons for kids up to grade 4, taught by our volunteer Sunday school teachers during the service.

Ask about this ministry

Youth Ministry

Led by Pastor Jaden Esquejo, our youth ministry disciples young people in the gospel and how it can be lived out.

Ask about this ministry

Young Adult Bible Study

For ages 18 and up. We meet in homes to catch up, study the Bible, and pray together about the questions of young adult life.

Ask about this ministry

Men’s Fellowship & Bible Study

Men encourage one another in the study of the Word and in everyday life. Usually meets during Connect Group time after the Sunday service.

Ask about this ministry

Women’s Fellowship & Bible Study

Women encourage one another in the study of the Word and in everyday life. Usually meets during Connect Group time after the Sunday service.

Ask about this ministry

Young Couple Fellowship

For young married and engaged couples. We apply biblical principles to marriage, with encouragement and prayer for one another.

Ask about this ministry

Wednesday Prayer Meeting

Led by Pastor Wendell Olojan. We pray for one another, our community, and those who are sick, with a devotional to dig deeper into the Word. Wednesdays at 7 PM, usually at 427 Matheson Avenue.
